description: This file defines the interface DeleteFeaturePropertiesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder, which provides factory methods for creating command responses and events related to the DeleteFeatureProperties command within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for building success and error responses, as well as events triggered by the command.
